sections.note: Current rates for 2026 income: Decreto-Lei n.º 212/2026, de 4 de novembro (Diário da República, 1.ª série, n.º 214, pp. 5-6, published 2026-11-04; promulgated 2026-11-02; in force from 2026-11-05, applying to income obtained from 2026-01-01). They replace the State Budget 2026 rates shown in the next table. Art. 68.º n.º 2: income above the first band is split, the top of the highest band it fills taxed at that band's average rate (column B) and the excess at the next marginal rate, which gives the same result as applying each marginal rate to its slice. Average rates at the top of each band: €8,342: 12.2%; €12,587: 13.212%; €17,838: 15.416%; €23,089: 17.277%; €29,397: 20.136%; €43,090: 24.732%; €46,566: 26.103%; €86,634: 34.658%. Madeira and the Azores apply their own reduced tables.
